62.sourceTitle: Aluminium Premium Duty paid US Midwest Price Today - Investing.com
62.evidenceText: 1,793.99 (shown as the Prev. Close, Open, and Day's Range value for Aluminium Premium Duty paid US Midwest)
62.extractionRationale: The source displays 1,793.99 as the price value with "Currency in USD" noted. This is in cents per pound (standard unit for aluminum premiums), so converted to USD/lb: 1,793.99 ÷ 100 = 17.94 USD/lb. Confidence is medium due to the page indicating this is historical/closed data with a note "For real-time data please try another search."
